Suppose $\pi : ( ilde{M}, ilde{g}) o (M, g)$ is a Riemannian submersion. If $Z$ is any vector field on $M$, we let $ ilde{Z}$ denote its horizontal lift to $ ilde{M}$ (see Prop. 2.25).

  1. Show that for every pair of vector fields $X, Y \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$, we have

    egin{align*} \langle ilde{X}, ilde{Y} angle & = \langle X, Y angle \circ \pi ; \[ ilde{X}, ilde{Y}]^H & = \widetilde{[X, Y]}; \[ ilde{X}, W]& ext{ is vertical if } W \in \mathfrak {X}( ilde{M}) ext{ is vertical.} \end{align*}

  2. Let $ ilde{ abla }$ and $ abla $ denote the Levi-Civita connections of $ ilde{g}$ and $g$, respectively. Show that for every pair of vector fields $X, Y \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$, we have

    egin{equation} ilde{ abla }_{ ilde{X}} ilde{Y} = \widetilde{ abla _X Y} + rac{1}{2} [ ilde{X}, ilde{Y}]^V. ag {5.27} \end{equation}

    [Hint: Let $ ilde{Z}$ be a horizontal lift and $W$ a vertical vector field on $ ilde{M}$, and compute $\langle ilde{ abla }_{ ilde{X}} ilde{Y}, ilde{Z} angle $ and $\langle ilde{ abla }_{ ilde{X}} ilde{Y}, W angle $ using (5.9).]

(Used on p. 224.) \end{exercise}
